title: Operation Strategy
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Strategy Formulation: Based on the characteristics of SMB and SAKA business structures, clarify strategies around different dimensions such as merchant basic information, review, and menus;
    identify key indicators, key initiatives, and implementation paths to ensure strategy feasibility.
  2. Strategy Implementation: Transform strategies into practical approaches suitable for frontline teams, rationally break down objectives, assign them to specific individuals and actions;
    coordinate resources toresolve key bottlenecks, ensuring strategies truly drive team members to achieve business goals. Coordinate and resolve cross-departmental collaboration and execution obstacles to ensure efficient implementation and a closed-loop process at each key stage.
  3. Strategy Evaluation and Iteration: Evaluate strategy effectiveness through data review and performance evaluation;
    propose adjustments to inefficient processes, forming a closed-loop strategy iteration system to continuously optimize city-level business.
  4. Resource and Tool Development: Develop SOPs for the entire business process. Create exclusive sales scripts, brand service reports, and case studies for chain merchants, forming replicable and efficient signing and closing strategies.
  5. Performance Scheme Development: Utilize data as a management tool to participate in the development of performance evaluation schemes for each module. Performance and incentives: Address sales momentum. Based on the goals at different stages, design new contract performance and incentive programs to stimulate sales momentum and drive efficient achievement of targets.


Job Requirements

  1. Education Background: Bachelor's degree or above.
  2. Work Experience: (Hard Requirements) At least 3 years of relevant work experience in the internet industry;
    (Hard Requirements) Familiarity with sales processes and rhythms, experience in strategy development and incentive mechanism design;
    experience in e-commerce or food delivery industry is preferred.
  3. Skills and Analytical Abilities: Possess clear logical thinking ability;
    (Hard Requirements) Familiarity with SQL and common business analysis methods, strong data sensitivity, and ability to independently analyze business problems and propose optimization suggestions.
  4. Project Management Ability: Ability to independently manage projects from initiation to completion.
  5. Collaboration Ability: Ability to efficiently coordinate internal and external teams, drive the execution of complex projects, and ensure timely completion of tasks.
  6. Language Requirements: (Hard Requirements) English CET-6 or above. A strong command of English is a plus.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Target Management
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Strategic Goal Decomposition and Planning: Utilizing clear logical thinking, scientifically decompose business goals into actionable and traceable process indicators (Input Metrics) for the team, calculate man-hour efficiency at each stage, and forecast manpower based on the efficiency of each task.
  2. End-to-End Achievement Monitoring and Early Warning: Monitor the team's order completion progress in real time, ensuring that key business indicators such as overall goal progress by city and module, as well as man-hour efficiency and other data are fully tracked and reported. Adjust manpower allocation and performance plans promptly, establish a goal early warning mechanism, and coordinate with the team for rapid response.
  3. Monitoring Efficiency Optimization: Utilize various methods (including but not limited to product tools, data analysis, etc.) to help build online data dashboards, efficiently perform data calculations, and monitor all modules.
  4. Data Metric System Optimization: Collaborate closely with product and data teams to ensure the online construction of the data metric system.
  5. In-Depth Business Insights and Diagnosis: Identify bottlenecks and opportunities for partner business growth through data analysis, identify key factors affecting performance, and propose improvement suggestions.


Job Requirements

  1. Bachelor's degree or above, with at least 3 years of experience in internet industry operations or data analysis;
    experience in food delivery is preferred.
  2. (Hard Requirements) Proficient in SQL, able to independently build dashboards, and skilled in data extraction, processing, and visualization. Strong data sensitivity, able to independently analyze business problems and propose optimization suggestions.
  3. Excellent business analysis and problem-solving skills;
    able to extract core insights from complex data and formulate actionable recommendations.
  4. Excellent project management and cross-departmental communication and coordination skills;
    able to effectively promote multi-party collaboration.
  5. Strong sense of purpose and responsibility;
    able to maintain high efficiency in a fast-paced environment.
  6. Language Requirements: Fluent English;
    those who can communicate in English as a working language are preferred.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Hardware Test & Verification Designer
description:
At TOPIC (in the Netherlands ) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designer

with a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting-edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?


“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”


Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded Systems


What will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required;
LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.


Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:

  • Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
  • Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
  • Conduct and support HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
  • Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams;
    a hands-on programming mindset is preferred;
  • Work in a structured, plan-oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
  • Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.


What do we offer you?

This will make you smarter:

  • Strategic projects in complex high-tech environments
  • Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
  • Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
  • Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessions


This will make you better:

  • Permanent contract
  • An all-in benefits package (€62.000 – €82.000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
  • 26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation support


This will keep you healthy:

  • Good work-life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
  • Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
  • Home office support for an inspiring work-from-home setup
  • Regular fun, social, and sports events


What do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
  • 5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
  • Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
  • Proficient in Python (required);
    experience with LabVIEW, TestStand, or C/C++ is a plus;
  • Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
  • Affinity with embedded software and firmware;
    hands-on programming skills are preferred;
  • Plan-oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
  • Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
  • Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
  • A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.


Our organization

Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions;
from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD;
technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.


Diversity & Inclusion

At TOPIC, we believe that true innovation happens when people with different backgrounds, ideas, and perspectives come together. Every talent counts, and every voice matters. Diversity strengthens our creativity, and inclusion ensures that everyone feels welcome and valued. We build a culture where everyone has the space to contribute and be themselves.

title: Leader-Merchant Informatization
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage.

In less than one year, Keeta became an industry leader in Hong Kong, China. Soon after, we expanded into Saudi Arabia and are now present in more than 20 cities. Following our recent successful launch in Qatar, Kuwait and the UAE, we're bringing that same speed and innovation to more of the Middle East, and to Brazil.


Job Responsibilities

  1. Team Management and Deliverables: Responsible for managing a local Keeta team of approximately 30-40 people in Brazil, responsible for uploading and verifying all merchant information, ensuring data efficiency, completeness, and accuracy. This requires balancing limited resources and delivering high-quality team results on time.
  2. Mechanism and Process Development: Establish comprehensive internal and external collaboration workflows and oversight mechanisms, continuously optimizing processes to ensure the team accurately and efficiently serves business needs.
  3. Core Metric Monitoring: Monitor and report key onboarding metrics, proactively identify and resolve issues to ensure a smooth onboarding experience for merchants.
  4. Team Collaboration: Work closely with sales, compliance, and product teams to streamline the onboarding process and meet merchant needs.
  5. Team Development and Capacity Building: Develop training materials and conduct onboarding training for new employees and merchants as needed.


Job Requirements

  1. Highly responsible and unwaveringly committed to achieving goals and results.
  2. Effective in resource management and problem-solving.
  3. A strong learner, eager to continuously acquire new skills and adapt to a constantly changing business environment.
  4. A proactive team player who supports colleagues and enhances team efficiency through excellent communication skills.
  5. Native Portuguese speaker, fluent in English (listening, speaking, reading, and writing).
  6. Experience in merchant operations support is preferred.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a bold vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 57 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

Assistência ao Chef de Cozinha

  • Suporte Diário: Auxiliar o chef de cozinha nas operações diárias e na preparação de pratos;
  • Substituição doChef: Assumir as responsabilidades do chef de cozinha na sua ausência.


Preparação e Cozinha

  • Preparação de Ingredientes: Garantir que todos os ingredientes estejam preparados e prontos para uso;
  • Cozinhar e Montar Pratos: Cozinhar pratos conforme as receitas e padrões estabelecidos.


Supervisão da Equipe

  • Coordenação da Equipe: Ajudar a coordenar e supervisionar a equipe de cozinha;
  • Treinamento: Ajudar no treinamento de novos funcionários.


Controle de Itens

  • Controle de Ingredientes: Verificar a disponibilidade dos ingredientes e solicitar reabastecimento conforme necessário;
  • Controle de Porções: Garantir que as porções sejam controladas para minimizar o desperdício.


Segurança e Higiene

  • Práticas de Higiene: Manter e aplicar as práticas de higiene e segurança alimentar;
  • Inspeções: Realizar inspeções regulares para garantir que todos os padrões sejam cumpridos.


Inovação e Melhoria

  • Desenvolvimento de Receitas: Contribuir com ideias para novos pratos e melhorias nos pratos existentes.
  • Feedback: Fornecer feedback ao chef de cozinha sobre o desempenho da equipe e a qualidade dos pratos.


Participar dos eventos e tirar dúvidas dos clientes em dia de degustação.


Formação:

  • Necessário possuir curso de formação em gastronomia (bacharelado preferível).


Experiência:

  • Experiência de 2 ou mais anos como Subchefe em restaurantes de alta gastronomia, bistrô e buffet;
  • Capaz de trabalhar em um ambiente acelerado;
  • Dedicado ao controle e qualidade dos alimentos;


Habilidades:

  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;
  • Atitude e iniciativa;
  • Saber trabalharem equipe.

title: Coordenador Operacional De Eventos
description:
PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES:

- Participar dos reuniões a fim de identificar e definir estratégias para a entrega do evento;

- Montar a escala de trabalho do time operacional de acordo com a demanda do evento e encaminhar para aprovação;

- Realizar briefing com o time operacional e alinhar o grau de expectativa do cliente;

- Receber e acompanhar os fornecedores e, nos casos de montagens, garantir o cumprimento das regras de segurança estabelecidas;

- Efetuar o check-list do evento de acordo com a Ordem de Serviço e realizar ajustes quando necessário;

- Supervisionar a montagem do evento de acordo com o layout definido;

- Checar e supervisionar a separação dos materiais internos que serão utilizados no evento e acompanhar a montagem;

- Receber o cliente final e/ou Cerimonial e se colocar à disposição;

- Coordenar o evento e garantir o padrão de qualidade, assim como o bem-estar dos convidados/participantes;

- Coordenar e orientar as equipes envolvidas para garantir a entregado do evento;

- Realizarinventário de louças e mobília periodicamente;

- Realizar o levantamento de itens danificados durante o evento e efetuar a cobrança de acordo com o contrato assinado;

- Encaminhar a ficha de avaliação para o cliente final e/ou cerimonial pós-evento;

- Executar outras tarefas correlatas à área.

FORMAÇÃO:

- Desejável formação nas áreas de Comunicação Social, Turismo e Hotelaria;

- Conhecimento no pacote Office;

- Inglês será um diferencial.

EXPERIÊNCIA:

- Experiência comprovada na área de organização/atendimento de eventos;

- Conhecimento de Office (Excel, Power Point e Word).

HABILIDADES:

- Liderança e gestão de equipes;

- Senso de análise e habilidades para gerir conflitos;

- Foco, dinamismo e disposição;

- Organização e planejamento de tarefas;

- Capacidade de Antecipação;

- Boa comunicação oral e escrita;

- Excelente comunicação e habilidades interpessoais;

- Disponibilidade de horário.

REQUISITOS ADICIONAIS:

- Possuir veículo próprio;

- Residir Vinhedo, Valinhos, Campinas, Jundiaí.

title: Assistente De Assessoria De Eventos
description:
O Grupo Imagem Eventos , empresa referência em soluções completas para eventos corporativos e sociais, está em busca de um(a) Assistente de Assessoria para Eventos para integrar sua equipe operacional.


O profissional será responsável por apoiar a execução dos eventos, assegurando a qualidade, a organização e o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos, além de prestar suporte no relacionamento com clientes e fornecedores.


Principais responsabilidades:
  • Apoiar o planejamento logístico e operacional dos eventos;
  • Acompanhar processos de montagem, execução e desmontagem;
  • Dar suporte no atendimento a clientes e fornecedores durante as etapas do evento;
  • Realizar controle e checagem de materiais, equipamentos e demandas operacionais;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento dos cronogramas e padrões de qualidade definidos pela coordenação;
  • Apoiar a equipede produção e demais áreas envolvidas na realização dos eventos.


Requisitos e qualificações:
  • Formação técnica ou superior em Eventos, Comunicação ou Administração ;
  • Experiência prévia em atividades operacionais ou de apoio à produção de eventos será considerada um diferencial;
  • Boa capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Organização, responsabilidade e atenção aos detalhes;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalho noturno, finais de semana e deslocamentos conforme a demanda dos eventos.


O Grupo Imagem Eventos oferece:
  • Ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e colaborativo;
  • Oportunidade dedesenvolvimento profissional e participação em projetos de destaque;
  • Integração a uma equipe comprometida com a excelência na entrega de experiências únicas em eventos.

title: Consultor De Vendas De Intercâmbio
description:
Sobre a Egali

Aqui na Egali sonhamos alto! Somos centenas de pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazemos. A nossa cultura é focada em construir um ambiente inclusivo e colaborativo, onde podemos ser a nossa melhor versão!

Sabemos que investir no potencial de nossos colaboradores é trazer ainda mais qualidade ao nosso negócio.

Nossa missão é promover o intercâmbio de forma responsável e por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos, com disposição para conectar pessoas aos seus sonhos.


Requisitos:

  • Conhecimento em intercâmbio/Geolocalização.
  • Cursando Ensino superior nas áreas: Administração, Relações Internacionais, Administração, Comércio Exterior, Gestão Empresarial, Gestão Comercial e áreas correlatadas;
  • Excelente relacionamento, escuta ativa e empática, comunicação assertiva, excelente redação e muita energia para colocar a mão na massa;
  • Organização e gestão do tempo também são habilidades fundamentais para esta posição;
  • Interesse e/ou experiencia com área comercial


Quais são as atividades?

  • Atender clientes via telefone, e-mail ou pessoalmente no escritório da empresa;
  • Fortalecimento das relações de parceria com divulgações das atividades da empresa;
  • Prospectar novos leads.
  • Atendimento personalizado e consultivo.


Vamos explorar o mundo juntos!

Na Egali, somos apaixonados por gente. Por isso, todas as nossas posições são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, de gêneros e orientação sexual diversas, incluindo todas as etnias e religiões. Estamos focados em construir um ambiente inclusivo e colaborativo, onde podemos ser sempre a nossa melhor versão!


A Egali Trail – Um plano individual de carreira em que você se desenvolve para Egali e para o mercado


Benefícios que Valorizam seu Trabalho:

  • Salário compatível com o mercado + comissão.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): Compartilhamento dos resultados da empresa com você.

Benefícios que Cuidam de Você:

  • Alimentação:
  • Vale Refeição (VR) ou Vale Alimentação (VA) - Para suas refeições diárias.
  • Saúde:
  • Convênio Médico - Cuidados com a sua saúde física.
  • Convênio Odontológico - Sorriso sempre saudável.
  • Totalpass - Acesso a diversas academias e estúdios para cuidar do corpo e da mente.
  • Subsídio com Psicóloga - Apoio para o seu bem-estar emocional.
  • Salvia (Plataforma de TeleNutri) - Orientação nutricional para uma vida mais saudável.

Benefícios para a Família:

  • Licença Maternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para você e seu bebê nos primeiros meses.
  • Credencial Total com o SESC: Diversão, cultura e serviços para você e sua família.

Benefícios para o seu Desenvolvimento:

  • Busuu (Plataforma de Idiomas): Aprenda um novo idioma e expanda seus horizontes.
  • Wizard (Descontos Exclusivos): Condições especiais em cursos de idiomas para você se desenvolver ainda mais.

Benefícios para o seu Dia a Dia:

  • Allya (Plataforma de Descontos Diversos): Economize em diversas categorias de produtos e serviços.
  • Flytour (Plataforma de Viagens com Exclusivos): Planeje suas viagens com condições especiais.

title: Manicure
description:
Realize atendimentos de Manicure, Pedicure e Spa dos pés. É preciso seguir os padrões de qualidade, higiene e biossegurança definidos pela Bluma. Também é esperado que você mantenha postura profissional, pontualidade e bom relacionamento com a equipe e com o público atendido. Todos os materiais necessários para os atendimentos, assim como o uniforme completo, serão disponibilizados pela Bluma. Os atendimento serão realizados em estabelecimentos da Bluma localizados em aeroportos.
Caso o(a) candidato(a) ainda não tenha MEI, a Bluma oferece apoio na abertura. Candidatos(as) com MEI pendente ou irregular serão desclassificadas.

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
About the role

Skyflow is a data privacy vault delivered via APIs. It helps companies isolate, protect, govern, and use sensitive data such as personal, health, or payment information securely, without losing usability. It's built on a zero-trust architecture, meaning no one gets access to data unless explicitly allowed.

Skyflow is looking for a Platform Engineer to support the SRE team and help design, build, and maintain scalable backend services and infrastructure. This role combines strong backend development skills with knowledge of SRE practices, contributing to the reliability, automation, and optimization of production systems. The Platform Engineer will collaborate closely with SREs, engineers, and business teams to ensure systems are performant, maintainable, and scalable.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a strong focus on backend development
  • Experience supporting infrastructure, automation, or reliability practices (SRE exposure is a plus)
  • Proficiency in backend programming languages such as Python, Go, or TypeScript
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration tools such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation), and automation
  • Hands-on experience with RDBMS and distributed systems
  • Ability to work collaboratively with SRE and engineering teams to support production systems
  • Understanding of application observability, monitoring, and performance best practices

Responsibilities:

  • Develop automation and tooling to improve system monitoring, incident response, and operational efficiency.
  • Build and maintain infrastructure as code using IaC technologies like Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant architectures.
  • Write production-grade code (Python, Go, or TypeScript) to automate infrastructure management and operational workflows.
  • Establish and enhance observability practices, including metrics, logging, tracing, and alerting.
  • Participate in on-call rotations, incident management, and post-incident reviews to drive continuous improvement.
  • Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation to support reliable software delivery.
  • Partner with developers to embed reliability and performance best practices throughout the development lifecycle.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.

title: Regional Data Visualization & BI Specialist
description:
Esta posición es clave para traducir datos en historias comprensibles a través de dashboards interactivos y efectivos. Colaborarás estrechamente con ingenieros de datos, project managers y equipos de cliente para definir soluciones de visualización que generen impacto.   • +5 años de experiencia comprobable diseñando dashboards en PowerBI, con un portafolio sólido que demuestre excelencia visual y analítica.
  • Dominio de Power Query para tareas de transformación de datos.
  • Sólidos conocimientos en DAX para la creación de KPIs y lógica analítica.
  • Conocimientos en modelado de datos y principios de UX/UI aplicados a visualización.
  • Manejo de BigQuery y lenguaje SQL.
  • Habilidad para comunicar resultados a públicos técnicos y no técnicos.
  • Experiencia trabajando en entornos ágiles.

Habilidades y características deseadas

  • Experiencia previa en la industria de medios o publicidad, especialmente en canales digitales como redes sociales o publicidad programática. (NO EXCLUYENTE)
  • Conocimiento en administración de espacios de trabajo en PowerBI y optimización de rendimiento.
  • Pasión por la innovación, iniciativa para aprender nuevas tecnologías de BI y compartir conocimientos con el equipo.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.

Job Summary

This is a full-time fully remote working opportunity where you will be working as part of a Scrum team which requires working closely with other software engineers, stakeholders and contributors on the project. Working with respect to the US timezone is a requirement for the position. Attending meetings, being actively involved in the decision making process and collaborating with all of these stakeholders are essential parts of this position.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and deploy scalable, production-ready machine learning systems and end-to-end pipelines on AWS.
  • Partner with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to define requirements, select algorithms, and deliver impactful ML solutions.
  • Architect, optimize, and maintain ML infrastructure — including data ingestion, model training, deployment, serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management — using AWS services.
  • Lead the data preparation and feature engineering process, ensuring data quality, integrity, and scalability across large datasets.
  • Implement and optimize ML models (supervised, unsupervised, deep learning, NLP, recommendation systems) with a focus on performance, accuracy, and reliability.
  • Build and manage robust data pipelines and orchestration workflows to support ML systems at scale.
  • Integrate models into backend services and APIs, ensuring seamless interaction with applications and end users.
  • Contribute to MLOps practices, including CI/CD for ML, model registries, experiment tracking, automated retraining, and infrastructure-as-code provisioning.
  • Utilize Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation to build and maintain scalable, secure ML infrastructure.
  • Stay ahead of emerging trends in AI/ML, evaluating new research, frameworks, and tools to enhance product capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers, guiding best practices throughout the ML lifecycle.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced written and oral English proficiency.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, or a related field.
  • 7+ years of professional experience designing, building, and deploying machine learning models in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS for ML workflows (data pipelines, model training, deployment, and monitoring).
  • Expert proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.
  • Proficiency with TypeScript for building ML-integrated backend services and automation workflows.
  • Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools (Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation) for deploying ML infrastructure.
  • Strong knowledge of data processing and analysis tools (Pandas, NumPy, SQL) and orchestration workflows.
  • Proven track record deploying ML systems into production and integrating them into real products or services at scale.
  • Experience with containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes), and MLOps best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, or agentic AI systems.
  • Expertise in deep learning, NLP, time-series forecasting, or computer vision.
  • Familiarity with platforms such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Amazon SageMaker for model lifecycle management.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or publications in the field.
  • Understanding of data engineering workflows, ETL pipelines, and real-time data processing

Benefits

  • Yearly Office Allowance Budget
  • Macbook Purchase Support
  • Wellbeing Support

If you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

We only accept CVs that are in English.

Flatiron has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, color, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be disregarded.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Software Engineer (Agents & Rapid Prototyping)

Location: Remote (US-friendly hours) - Central Time Zone

Type: Full-time (founding/early engineer)

Team: Small, passionate, ego-free builders

Why this role

We're hunting for product–market fit. That means we ship POCs fast, test hypotheses daily, and aren't afraid to throw work away if the data says so. If you code for fun, ask "why" before "how," and love turning messy problems into scrappy automation that actually saves people time—this is your playground.

So we're on the same page, Vibe-Coding is helpful to very quickly discuss feature requirements and expectations before we commit to a full build.

What you'll do

  • Prototype at lightning speed: Build and ship POCs, internal tools, and production features in days—not weeks.
  • Work with LLMs & SLMs: Integrate, evaluate, and fine-tune models; design agentic workflows that reduce manual work.
  • Automate the boring stuff: Sniff out bottlenecks, redundancies, and paper cuts; replace them with lightweight automations.
  • Balance build vs. buy: Pragmatically choose off-the-shelf services vs. custom code; optimize for speed, cost, and learning.
  • Own the stack end-to-end: APIs, data models, frontends, deployments, instrumentation, and on-call for what you build.
  • Collaborate without ego: Pair with design, product, and GTM to clarify the "why," define thin slices, and ship continuously.
  • Ruthlessly iterate: Be comfortable restarting weekly if needed; measure outcomes, not lines of code.

Outcomes (how we'll measure success)

  • 2–3 prod-quality launches/month from idea → shipped.
  • Clear learning loops: each release produces measurable signal (conversion, retention, time-saved).
  • Automation ROI: hours saved/team/week; decreased cycle time; reduced ops tickets.
  • Agent impact: at least one agent in steady use by internal or pilot users within first 60 days.

You might be a fit if you

  • Have 4+ years building full-stack products (or equivalent portfolio/hacker track record).
  • Are fluent in a modern web stack (e.g., TypeScript/Node, Python, React/Next; Postgres/Redis; REST/GraphQL).
  • Have shipped LLM/SLM features (tool use, RAG, function calling, evals, latency/cost tuning).
  • Can design simple, resilient backends; write clean, testable code; and deploy via CI/CD to a major cloud.
  • Love debugging with data: logs, traces, metrics; you instrument before you guess.
  • Communicate crisply, ask sharp questions, and default to action.
  • Thrive in ambiguity; you don't need a JIRA novella to start building.

Nice to have

  • Vector DBs, embeddings, prompt/version management, offline evals.
  • Agent frameworks (e.g., OpenAI tools, LangGraph, custom planners/executors).
  • Queueing/event systems (e.g., Kafka, SQS), WebSockets, streaming.
  • Security and privacy basics (authn/z, secrets, PII handling).
  • Experience with low-cost scrappy stacks (Cloudflare, Fly.io, Supabase, Firebase).

Our stack (evolving)

  • FE: React/Next.js, Tailwind, tRPC/GraphQL
  • BE: Node/TypeScript and/or Python FastAPI
  • Data: Postgres, Redis/Upstash, optional vector store
  • Infra: Vercel/Fly.io/Cloudflare + Docker; CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
  • AI: OpenAI, Anthropic, local SLMs when useful; evaluation harness + prompt/version control

How we work

  • Learn > Perfect: Ship thin slices, get signal, iterate.
  • Write it down: Short RFCs → prototype → user feedback within days.
  • Builder culture: No rockstars, no heroes—just ownership and curiosity.
  • Time-zone friendly: Async first; quick huddles when needed.

Interview flow

  • Intro chat (30 min): goals, mindset, what great looks like.
  • Builder exercise (home or live, 2–4 hrs): ship a tiny agent or automation; explain trade-offs.
  • Technical deep dive (60 min): architecture, data modeling, reliability, AI evals/cost.
  • Team fit (30 min): collaboration, feedback loops, "why before what."

Compensation

Competitive salary + meaningful equity. We optimize for ownership and impact.

title: ServiceNow Developer
description:
This is a fully remote position and is an ongoing contract (PJ).

The ServiceNow Developer's job description involves designing, developing, and implementing custom applications and workflows on the ServiceNow platform to automate business processes. Key responsibilities include creating and configuring modules like ITSM, writing code (JavaScript, HTML, CSS), integrating with other systems, and troubleshooting technical problems. Developers work with stakeholders to gather requirements and ensure platform stability across different environments.

Core responsibilities

  • Development and configuration:

Build and configure custom applications, forms, workflows, and scripts within the ServiceNow platform. This includes using features like Business Rules, Client Scripts, and Flow Designer.

  • Requirements and design:

Collaborate with business analysts and other stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.

  • Integration:

Develop and maintain integrations with other IT systems and third-party tools using technologies like SOAP and REST web services.

  • Maintenance and support:

Provide ongoing production support, troubleshoot issues, and manage platform upgrades and patches.

  • Testing and quality assurance:

Create test cases and perform quality checks to ensure the reliability and efficiency of new applications.

Technical skills:

Proficiency in JavaScript, HTML, and CSS, along with experience in ServiceNow scripting (e.g., Script Includes, UI Actions).

Platform knowledge:

Hands-on experience with various ServiceNow modules such as IT Service Management (ITSM), IT Operations Management (ITOM), or Configuration Management Database (CMDB).

Methodologies:

Experience with Agile development methodologies like Scrum is required.

Soft skills:

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills are essential for gathering requirements and collaborating with team members.

Education:

A bachelor's degree in a related field like computer science or information technology is generally required.

ServiceNow Professional System Administrator certification or higher.

Certified Application Developer (CAD) credential

Experience:

  • 5+ years' experience as a ServiceNow Developer with documented work experience.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

As a DevOps Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to infrastructure automation, continuous delivery, observability, and security by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams. The DevOps engineer evaluates emerging technologies, promotes process improvements, and shapes standards and best practices while providing expert guidance to project teams across the organization. This role plays a fundamental role in driving the adoption of cloud platform capabilities in collaboration with software engineering, architecture, and information security teams

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Deploy & Configure AWS Cloud Services;
  • Deploy & Configure Kubernetes resources;
  • Help elaborating or contributing to RFC and ADRs documents describing technical solutions;

  • CI/CD Pipeline Automation – Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions;
  • Observability & Monitoring – Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting solutions;
  • Disaster Recovery & Security – Develop automated backup strategies, define disaster recovery plans, and implement security best practices;
  • Workflow Automation & Integration – Build integrations to automate deployment processes, security checks, and operational workflows.

Essential Skills

  • Experience in a DevOps role, with hands-on AWS experience;
  • Experience with IaC tools, ideally Terraform and Helm Charts;
  • Experience with containerization tools (Docker, Kubernetes);
  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools like CircleCI and GithubActions;

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Networking & Security – Familiarity with DNS, Zero Trust, load balancing, IAM, firewall rules, VPNs, and cloud security best practices;
  • Monitoring & Observability – Experience using Datadog, CloudWatch;
  • Experience with Kubernetes packet managers (e.g. Helm, Kubectl);
  • AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Associate or AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate.

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora's technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: CRA II or Senior CRA
description:
We are currently seeking a Clinical Research Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Clinical Research Associate at ICON, you will play a pivotal role in designing and analyzing clinical trials, interpreting complex medical data, and contributing to the advancement of innovative treatments and therapies.
What You Will Be Doing
  • Completes onsite and remote monitoring activities in accordance with all ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations, SOPs and study processes. Activities include qualifying potential investigative sites, initiating clinical trials, maintaining study files, providing instructions to site personnel and study close out.
  • Verifies the protection of study participants by confirming informed consent procedures and protocol have been performed in accordance to applicable regulations.
  • Ensures the integrity of clinical data and that the study is conducted in compliance with approved protocol, GCP, applicable regulations and SOPs.
  • Manages the investigative site staff to facilitate trial deliverables, e.g., subject enrollment, data deliverables.
  • Verifies proper management and accountability of Investigational Product (IP).
  • Writes and submits reports of investigational site findings and updates applicable tracking systems. Escalates observed deficiencies, issues, and corrective and preventative action plans as appropriate.
  • Manages essential documents as required by local regulations and ICH-GCP guidelines before, during and after a clinical study; assists with resolution of investigational site/data queries.
  • Performs key risk assessment and management responsibilities throughout the project, including key risk indicator and site health analysis, site process evaluation, and project escalation.
  • Participates in audit preparation and follow-up activities as needed.
  • Independently performs a variety of onsite and offsite monitoring visit types.
  • Gathers and reviews information for assigned siteand identifies inconsistencies. With limitedguidance from project and functional management, assesses risk and escalatesas appropriate.
  • Assists with non-complex adhoc, short-term assignmentin support of additional studies or departmental initiatives.
  • May serve as preceptor, providing training to less experienced clinical team members.
  • Undergraduate degree or international equivalent in clinical, science, or healthrelated field from an accredited institution; health care professional licensure, i.e., registered nurse
  • Previous experience supporting clinical trials including solid on-site monitoring experience in CROs or pharma companies.
  • Travel is required 50-80%.
  • All employees must read, write and speak fluent English and host country language
What ICON Can Offer You
Our success depends on the quality of our people. That's why we've made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.
In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well-being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.
Visit our careers website to read more about the benefits of working at ICON:
At ICON, inclusion & belonging are fundamental to our culture and values. We're dedicated to providing an inclusive and accessible environment for all candidates. ICON is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please let us know through the form below. Interested in the role, but unsure if you meet all of the requirements? We would encourage you to apply regardless – there's every chance you're exactly what we're looking for here at ICON whether it is for this or other roles.

title: Project Manager Sênior
description:
Project Manager Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você será responsável por conduzir a execução de projetos estratégicos, garantindo que cada etapa — do planejamento ao deploy — aconteça dentro dos prazos, orçamentos e expectativas estabelecidas. Seu papel envolve coordenar equipes multidisciplinares, monitorar riscos, assegurar uma comunicação eficaz entre todas as partes envolvidas e garantir o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da companhia.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Acompanhar o progresso de cada fase do projeto (refinamento, planejamento, desenvolvimento, testes, homologação, deploy e operação assistida), garantindo que as entregas ocorram dentro do cronograma e com qualidade;
  • Monitorar e reportar o andamento das atividades, promovendo visibilidade e alinhamento constante com stakeholders;
  • Validar o planejamento de sprints e prioridades, garantindo aderência aos objetivos estratégicos;
  • Gerir recursos humanos e financeiros, assegurando a eficiência na alocação e uso dos investimentos;
  • Produzir materiais e relatórios de status para comitês executivos e áreas envolvidas;
  • Atuar na mitigação de riscos e na remoção de impedimentos que possam impactar o sucesso do projeto.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos corporativos complexos, preferencialmente no setor financeiro, de energia ou utilities;
  • Capacidade de coordenação entre múltiplas áreas, mantendo alinhamento entre tecnologia, negócio e stakeholders;
  • Domínio em monitoramento de prazos, gestão de riscos e orçamentação de projetos;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e executiva;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e entendimento de processos de desenvolvimento de software (refinamento, testes, deploy e operação assistida).

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver background financeiro ou experiência direta com gestão orçamentária e controle de custos;
  • Já tiver atuado em projetos de transformação digital ou inovação;
  • Possuir certificações como PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM ou afins;
  • Demonstrar habilidade para traduzir necessidades estratégicas em planos de execução práticos;
  • Tiver facilidade em construir relações de confiança e colaboração entre times técnicos e executivos.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber

Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  • Inscrição
  • Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  • Bate-papo com People
  • Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  • Entrevista técnica com liderança
  • Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  • Feedback final
  • Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Lider Tecnico de Sustentação (FullStack)
description:
A Keyrus acredita na diversidade e na inclusão. Encorajamos a todos a participarem em nosso processo de contratação, não importando o gênero, idade, raça, religião. Não permitimos nenhum tipo de discriminação. Isto é reforçado no processo de contratação e vivido dessa forma na empresa.

Sabemos que grandes resultados só são alcançados com uma grande equipe, por isso procuramos pessoas talentosas e apaixonadas, com desejo de crescer profissionalmente e criar uma trajetória de carreira conosco.

Estamos em busca de um Líder Técnico de Sustentação (FullStack) para integrar nossa equipe. Esse profissional será responsável por liderar tecnicamente as operações, gerenciar prioridades técnicas, garantir a eficiência das entregas, identificar e mitigar riscos, além de atuar como um ponto de conexão entre diferentes áreas da empresa.

Além disso, será essencial implementar melhorias nos processos e garantir a adequada transição de conhecimento de sistemas em publicação.

  • Idealizar, conduzir e implementar melhorias e evoluções nos processos existentes.
  • Realizar transições de sistemas em fase de publicação junto aos times de desenvolvimento, absorvendo o conhecimento necessário para suporte em produção.

title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Full Stack Software Engineer with 5+ years of software development experience. Candidates must have a strong background in React.js and experience with either Golang, Node.js, or Java, with a strong desire to adopt Golang as the primary back-end technology.

In this position, you will play a foundational role in building the core platform that enables power utilities to shift from decades-old legacy systems into an AI-native future. Candidates must bring working proficiency with AI tools and APIs to ensure seamless integration of intelligent functionality into the client's products.

This role requires strong coding fundamentals, system design capability, and the mindset of a builder who thrives in a startup environment. You will work in small, agile teams reporting directly to the CTO, collaborating closely with AI engineers, security leaders, and product managers. Together, you will build and deliver AI-native services delivered at startup speed.

Our client is building an AI-centric operating system for utilities. It harnesses AI at the enterprise level to better orchestrate customer delight, facilitate power optimization, improve the health of the grid, and unlock flexibility at scale. Funded by a strategic industry partner and one of the founders at Groupon, the client is poised to transform how utilities run and how customers experience energy.

Responsibilities

  • Front-End Development: Build, implement, and maintain front-end applications
  • Back-End Architecture & Development: Design, implement, and maintain APIs, services, and distributed systems that form the backbone of the client's OS
  • AI Integration: Collaborate with AI engineers to integrate models, embeddings, and agent services into back-end systems. Operate AI APIs, ensuring outputs are production-ready and aligned with enterprise utility requirements.
  • System Modernization: Transform legacy workflows into modern, secure, scalable codebases using cloud-native best practices
  • Security & Compliance: Partner with security leaders to ensure all services adhere to stringent utility-sector regulations, implementing secure coding practices by default
  • Agile Delivery: Deliver features and improvements in cycles measured in weeks, balancing speed with reliability

Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience in SaaS or enterprise environments
  • Strong proficiency in React, Python, and either Golang, Node.js, or Java (non-Golang developers will learn and adopt Golang on the job)
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high-quality code in fast-moving teams
  • Basic proficiency with AI/ML tooling (e.g., calling APIs, integrating model outputs)
  • Solid understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL), message queues, and distributed architectures
  • Cloud-native engineering experience (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Clear communicator, adaptable, eager to learn and grow AI capabilities over time
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability in small teams

Desired Experience

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience working on ERP systems or within the power utilities industry

Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture, share knowledge, be inclusive, learn, and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued team members for our clients. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Desenvolvedor IA
description:
Somos uma empresa do Grupo Stefanini. Especializados em marketing digital, utilizamos uma abordagem integrada que combina tecnologia, inteligência de dados, design e profundo conhecimento do comportamento do consumidor. Nosso foco está em potencializar os resultados de nossos parceiros, oferecendo soluções que vão desde consultoria estratégica até a execução e acompanhamento dos projetos. Com um time dedicado e altamente qualificado, a Gauge se destaca por sua capacidade de entender as necessidades específicas de cada cliente e entregar resultados de alta performance.

Com forte presença na América Latina e em expansão nos Estados Unidos, estamos sempre na vanguarda, aplicando as últimas tendências de mercado e mantendo um olhar atento à inovação contínua.

DESENVOLVEDOR IA

Como Desenvolvedor Sr / Especialista de IA "Hands On", você atuará em parceria com a equipe de desenvolvimento, não apenas liderando, mas também contribuindo ativamente para a codificação e implementação de soluções inovadoras. Sua experiência técnica e sua paixão pela IA serão essenciais para guiar o time na criação de soluções escaláveis e de alto desempenho.

Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar soluções de software utilizando tecnologias de inteligência artificial.
  • Trabalhar com algoritmos e técnicas específicas de IA, incluindo NLP e aprendizado de máquina.
  • Implementar soluções de IA utilizando linguagens de programação como Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js.
  • Utilizar frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain, para desenvolver soluções escaláveis.
  • Implementar soluções de NLP com ferramentas como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Realizar pré-processamento de texto, incluindo tokenização, criação de embeddings e remoção de stop words.
  • Trabalhar com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Porte (LLMs), como GPT e Llama, aplicando melhores práticas de arquitetura de software.
  • Desenvolver aplicações web utilizando frameworks como FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Colaborar na implementação de soluções utilizando MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para a implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Participar de processos de HAG (Hiper-Agilidade) para garantir entregas rápidas e eficientes.
  • Integrar e otimizar embeddings para melhorar a performance das soluções de IA.
  • Mentorizar e apoiar os membros da equipe, promovendo um ambiente de aprendizado e colaboração.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência com N8N é obrigatória.
  • Experiência com RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) e otimização de embeddings.
  • Experiência sólida no desenvolvimento de software para aplicações de inteligência artificial.
  • Proficiência em linguagens de programação: Python, JavaScript/TypeScript/Node.js ou Go.
  • Experiência com frameworks de IA, como PyTorch, Scikit-Learn e Langchain.
  • Conhecimento em bibliotecas de NLP, como NLTK, spaCy e Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Experiência em pré-processamento de texto e implementação de LLMs.
  • Vivência em arquiteturas de software escaláveis e de alto desempenho voltadas para IA.
  • Conhecimento em desenvolvimento web com FastAPI e React (NextJS).
  • Experiência com MLOps, Docker e Kubernetes para implantação de modelos de IA.
  • Habilidade de trabalho em equipe e boa comunicação.

title: Language Specialist
description:
Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine.

By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we're helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms.

Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Language Specialist – AI Training & Evaluation

About the Role:

We are seeking highly skilled Language Specialists to contribute to the training and enhancement of Large Language Models (LLMs). In this role, you will leverage your linguistic expertise to evaluate prompts, rate AI-generated outputs, and create high-quality content that helps refine AI performance. You will play a critical role in shaping the accuracy, fluency, and cultural relevance of AI systems used by global technology leaders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate prompts and responses generated by AI models to ensure linguistic accuracy, coherence, and contextual relevance.
  • Serve as a rater by providing structured feedback on AI outputs, identifying errors, biases, or inconsistencies.
  • Develop, edit, and curate high-quality content for training datasets across diverse domains.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams of linguists, data annotators, and AI researchers.
  • Ensure cultural and linguistic nuances are well-represented in model training.
  • Follow established guidelines while also contributing feedback to improve evaluation frameworks.

Qualifications:

  • Master's degree (or higher) in Linguistics, Language Studies, Translation, or related field.
  • Strong command of written and spoken language with excellent grammar and stylistic skills.
  • Experience in content writing, editing, or evaluation preferred.
  • Analytical mindset with attention to detail and ability to identify subtle linguistic issues.
  • Interest in AI, natural language processing (NLP), or large language models is a plus.

Also you need to go through two assessments,so kindly apply only if you will be available for the assessment and ready to collaborate for the project.

title: Executivo de vendas
description:
Sobre a Verzo:

A Verzo foi fundada em 2015 com o objetivo de auxiliar os hospitais e prestadores de serviço de saúde a aprimorarem seus resultados financeiros. Iniciamos movidos pelo propósito de ajudar a saúde do Brasil e animados com os desafios que o setor propicia.

Começamos como Aliança Hospitalar, prestando serviços de consultoria para hospitais. Logo nos apaixonamos por tecnologia e criamos o sistema VERZO. Com um time qualificado, o VERZO cresceu de forma exponencial e hoje atuamos com hospitais de todos os portes e perfis em todos os cantos do Brasil. Nos tornamos nativos de tecnologia e adotamos o nome VERZO para nossa companhia.

Durante a pandemia, percebemos o impacto causado não só nas instituições mas também nas pessoas. Decidimos lançar novas soluções de simples adesão, rápida implantação e que facilitassem a vida dos profissionais da área da saúde.

Hoje atendemos os hospitais e redes mais exigentes em termos de tecnologia e resultados. Estamos sempre inovando e criando novas soluções em parcerias com nossos clientes.

Viemos para ficar, valorizamos relações duradouras e a satisfação de nossos clientes é nosso principal objetivo.

O que fazemos:

Por meio de ciência de dados proprietária, nossas ferramentas trazem um ROI (retorno do investimento) claro e atrativo, além de apoiarmos as equipes na gestão financeira, cadastro, ciclo de receita, suprimentos e fiscal no atingimento de seus objetivos. Já foram identificados mais de R$ 2 bilhões em oportunidades de aumento de lucro para +350 clientes no país.

Formamos parcerias com essas equipes que, com o uso de nossas ferramentas, entregam mais resultados para seus gestores como redução de glosas/bloqueios, aumento da rentabilidade de medicamentos e materiais médicos, tanto via redução de custos quanto aumento de receita e revisão de mix, e automatização de processos de controle da cadeia de fornecedores e fiscais. Além disso, otimizamos processos internos via tecnologia para liberar tempo da equipe para dedicar atenção e esforços ao que realmente gera valor.

Tudo que desenvolvemos foi com base no feedback das dores destas equipes em diversos hospitais Brasil afora. Conhecemos profundamente as necessidades do setor e sabemos como ajudar.

Prêmios e reconhecimentos:

A Verzo é celebrada por sua excelência em inovação e qualidade de serviço. Fomos honrados com diversos reconhecimentos ao longo de nossa história como os destaques de "Tendência para a Saúde em 2024" pela Revista Medicina S/A em 2024, "Top Latin America HealthTech" pela HeathCare Tech Outlook em 2022, e selecionados pela Endeavor como uma das empresas de alto impacto no Brasil por meio do programa Scale Up Endeavor no mesmo ano.

Descrição da vaga e responsabilidades:

Estamos em busca de um Executivo de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe. As principais responsabilidades da posição incluem:

  • Prospectar ativamente novos clientes.
  • Gerenciar funil de vendas de ponta a ponta: prospecção, qualificação, apresentações, propostas e fechamento.
  • Conduzir reuniões de demonstração do produto.
  • Negociar aspectos comerciais e garantir a melhor experiência do cliente durante o processo comercial.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de Marketing e Customer Success para alinhar estratégias e melhorar a jornada do cliente.
  • Alimentar e organizar o CRM, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline.
  • Atingir e superar metas de vendas

Local de trabalho:

O trabalho será remoto, permitindo desempenho das funções de onde desejar. Por vezes, haverá necessidade de viagens para eventos e encontros presenciais com clientes.

Regime de contratação:

Contrato PJ

Requisitos mínimos:

Ao liderar iniciativas de desenvolvimento de negócios, você desempenha um papel crucial no crescimento da Verzo e na melhoria contínua da saúde no Brasil. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para o sucesso dos hospitais parceiros, proporcionando resultados tangíveis e impactando positivamente a qualidade dos serviços de saúde oferecidos.

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em saúde, tecnologia e SaaS.
  • Histórico consistente de atingimento ou superação de metas.
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, consultiva e orientada a soluções.
  • Possuir conhecimento do setor de saúde e do segmento hospitalar
  • Capacidade de lidar com diferentes perfis de clientes e influenciadores de decisão (C-level, gestores e técnicos).
  • Conhecimento em gestão de funil de vendas e ferramentas de CRM.
  • Disponibilidade para participação em eventos e encontros presenciais que envolvam viagens.
  • Imersão no entendimento dos produtos da Verzo e nas metodologias de vendas, com foco em SPICED, SPIN e CHALLENGER SALE.

O que valorizamos:

  • Experiência prévia no setor de saúde.
  • Perfil empreendedor, autônomo e orientado a resultados.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente dinâmico e de rápido crescimento.
  • Interesse genuíno em gerar impacto positivo no setor de saúde, via inovação, inteligência de dados e tecnologia
  • Possuir contatos com profissionais do setor e/ou carteira de clientes ativa.

—

Estamos ansiosos para conhecer você e explorar como podemos construir uma jornada de sucesso juntos.

Se você está em busca de uma oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa que valoriza a inovação e a excelência na saúde, a Verzo é o lugar ideal para você. Venha fazer parte do nosso time e contribuir com a vida!

title: Application Support Engineer - Salesforce & Azure (Specright / PDMS / Interius)
description:
We are seeking an Application Support Engineer to provide end-to-end technical and functional support for two enterprise platforms — Specright / PDMS (Salesforce-based) and Interius (Azure-hosted). This role will be responsible for ensuring smooth daily operations, resolving incidents, maintaining data integrity, and supporting integration enhancements across both systems.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide Tier 2/3 application support for the Specright PDMS and Interius platforms, managing incidents, service requests, and troubleshooting data and access issues.
  • Maintain and improve integrations between Salesforce-based and Azure-hosted systems; collaborate with middleware teams to configure, test, and monitor API and data connections.
  • Develop, modify, and troubleshoot Salesforce Data Loader scripts for bulk data imports, updates, and migrations.
  • Support supplier onboarding, user administration, and role-based access configuration.
  • Collaborate with business and IT teams to analyze issues, validate solutions, and optimize workflows.
  • Participate in integration testing, documentation of technical specifications, and maintenance of operational playbooks.
  • Liaise with vendor support teams (Salesforce, Specright) for escalated issues and platform enhancements.
  • Monitor system performance, identify improvement opportunities, and contribute to continuous process and system optimization.

Required Skills & Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS application support (Salesforce preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with APIs (REST/SOAP), authentication (OAuth/SSO), and data integration.
  • Experience with Salesforce Data Loader or similar ETL tools.
  • Exposure to Microsoft Azure environments and integration workflows.
  • Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills; able to work independently in a global environment.
  • Experience supporting packaging, supplier, or product data management systems is a plus.

title: Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience
description:
About the Product:

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose:

The Cloud Engineer with Data Platforms Experience will be responsible for building and maintaining cloud infrastructure and applications that primarily interface with data platforms, as well as building and maintaining Python-based applications that may or may not be deployed in the cloud. This role will ensure that our cloud environments and data-centric applications are built, configured, optimized, and adopted to meet evolving needs. The Cloud Engineer will own infrastructure requirements, configuration standards, performance optimization, and cross-team coordination related to cloud and data platforms.

Duties and Responsibilities:

Cloud Infrastructure and Data Platforms

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable and secure cloud infrastructure that supports data platforms.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based data platforms such as BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, etc.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure-as-code solutions using tools like Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Implement and manage cloud-based CI/CD workflows for infrastructure and data platform deployments.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud resource performance and cost.
  • Ensure data quality checks for source, integration, and reporting layers; escalate defects with clear reproduction steps and impact.

Python Application Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain Python-based applications, both cloud-deployed and on-premises.
  • Utilize Python libraries such as Flask for application development.
  • Implement and manage CI/CD workflows for Python applications.
  • Collaborate with development teams to integrate applications with cloud and data platforms.

Collaboration and Communication

  • Serve as a primary liaison among business leads, product managers, and data/engineering teams.
  • Facilitate demos, knowledge-sharing sessions, and best-practice documentation for data solutions.
  • Promote adoption of new data capabilities and practices; gather feedback for continuous improvement.

Release and Change Management

  • Coordinate release plans, timelines, and stakeholder readiness for data model and SQL deployments.
  • Ensure training, job aids, and rollout communications are prepared and delivered for data solutions.
  • Track post-release issues, adoption, and stabilization metrics related to data platforms.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:

  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • "Can-do" attitude with unwavering ethics and a willingness to help others.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Willingness to embrace relational nuances, own personal mistakes, be empathetic, address conflicts directly and transparently, and commit to self-reflection and self-betterment.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.

Requirements:

  • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms, e.g., BigQuery/Redshift, GCS/S3, and etc.
  • Infrastructure-as-code solutions, e.g., Terraform/CloudFormation.
  • Cloud-based CI/CD workflows.
  • Performance and cost optimization for cloud resources.
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with libraries such as Flask.
  • Experience with Git and Git providers, e.g., GitHub/BitBucket/GitLab.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Cloud-based IAM, networking, and security.
  • Experience with data orchestration frameworks, e.g., Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, dbt.
  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools.

Credentials and Experience:

  • College degree or equivalent life/work experience.
  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems administration, or product operations within SaaS, marketing technology, higher ed tech, or related domains.

We offer:

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health/Sport Budget.
  • Fully remote.
